entries.a: We're open Monday to Friday, 09:00–18:00, and Saturday 10:00–14:00. Closed Sundays and public holidays.
We're at 12 Rue de la Paix, and there's parking behind the building. The entrance is on the courtyard side.
Standard engagements start at €2,500. The final figure depends on scope, so we quote after a short call rather than guessing up front.
Typical lead time is two to three weeks from signed scope. Urgent work can sometimes be slotted sooner — worth asking.
Send three times that suit you and we'll confirm one. Calls are 30 minutes and there's no charge for the first one.
We handle front-office automation: intake across phone, email, chat and messaging, routed into whatever system you already run.
